authority.sourceOfTruth: SES/SSS/SPS canonical semantic and publication records
authority.promotionBoundary: publication remains an explicit protected effect

unsupported: SSS does not decide domain truth
generated context is not canonical semantic state

compatibility.behavior: surface resolution is read-only over canonical state
compatibility.semantics: meaning, surface, expression, and publication remain separated
compatibility.authority: domain truth stays with its owning system
compatibility.evidence: resolution traces and publication receipts remain recoverable

checks: unknown and withheld states remain distinct
surface resolution has trace and dependencies
publication requires explicit contract and receipt

migration.adopt: bind existing semantic sources without copying their authority
migration.repin: recompute affected surfaces after protocol changes
migration.deviation: record renderer or domain deviations explicitly
